_comment: Where the Streamlit app downloads the trained model: the GitHub Release v1.0.0 assets of this repository (artifacts/model/model.joblib and artifacts/model/metadata.json). The checksums pin the exact files trained by `python -m nca.train --config configs/robust.json`; after retraining, regenerate them with `python scripts/model_checksums.py` and publish the new files under a new tag.
